    Basicness of admissible bound-quiver algebras #

    The positive path-length filtration survives an arbitrary admissible relation quotient; no monomial hypothesis is needed. Its positive part is nilpotent, every vertex endomorphism is a scalar plus a positive term, and maps between distinct displayed vertices are positive. Consequently the displayed vertex endomorphism rings are local and the quotient category is skeletal.
